_lisezmoi: Every specification, date and price reference of the site lives here, never typed in a page (RECETTE §4). Each value was read on the source named in `sources` on `retrieved_at`. Mintages are in mintages.json, built by scripts/build-mintages.py from data/mint-tables/.

metals._note: World Bank Pink Sheet, monthly averages in US dollars, file updated on 2 October 2026. $/mt for base metals, $/troy oz for silver. The pages show the live price from gold-api.com when the browser can reach it, else these.

alloys._note: Weight in grams and metal shares. Bronze, steel, war nickel, 90% silver and 40% silver-clad: Bureau of the Mint 1981 book (Table VI and specification tables). Zinc cent and the 1982 change: Mint annual report FY1982. Clad coins, nickel and golden dollar: US Mint coin specifications page. Tin in older bronze and manganese are not priced: their share counts as zinc or as nothing, which the method page states.
